title: Recover a Specified AGV Through the OptiSweep WCS API
summary: Use the OptiSweep / WCS API through Apidog or an equivalent WCS API client to submit the POST RecoverAgv operation with a confirmed robot ID. RecoverAgv requests Geek to add the specified AGV back into the system. Verify the result with the Get Agv Statuses request.
when_to_use: Use when a specified AGV must be added back into the OptiSweep system through the Geek Plus recovery path and a confirmed robot ID is available.
not_for: Do not use without a confirmed robot ID.
Do not use as a physical AGV recovery or E-stop procedure.
Do not use to infer success from request submission alone; verify the AGV in Get Agv Statuses.

roles_and_responsibilities.responsibility: Use the Apidog / WCS API client to submit RecoverAgv and verify the specified AGV in the returned status.
Provide deeper support when the request cannot be submitted or the AGV does not reappear in the system state.

safety_notes: Confirm the robot ID before submitting the RecoverAgv request.
Stop and escalate if the API request cannot be submitted or the specified AGV does not reappear in the system state.
access_or_tools_needed: Apidog or equivalent WCS API client on the primary server
GET Get Agv Statuses operation for verification

access_required: L2_support access to the OptiSweep / WCS API through Apidog or an equivalent API client
system_preconditions: A confirmed robot ID is available for the specified AGV.

visual_references.description: Apidog / WCS API overview showing the AGVs API group and available operations, including POST RecoverAgv and GET Get Agv Statuses.
AGVs API view showing POST RecoverAgv and the requirement for a robot ID to add the specified AGV to the system.
AGV status result showing the fields returned by Get Agv Statuses, including name, state, command status, battery, status, and error fields.

steps.title: Open the RecoverAgv operation in Apidog
steps.purpose: Select the live OptiSweep / WCS API operation used to request that Geek add the specified AGV back into the system.
steps.instruction: In Apidog or an equivalent OptiSweep / WCS API client, open the AGVs API group and locate the POST RecoverAgv operation.
steps.expected_result: The AGVs API list displays the POST RecoverAgv operation and it is available for submission.
steps.healthy_condition: The POST RecoverAgv operation is visible in the AGVs API group.
steps.failure_condition: The AGVs API group or POST RecoverAgv operation is unavailable, or the request cannot be opened for submission.

actions.label: Locate RecoverAgv
actions.exact_action: Locate the AGVs API operation labeled POST RecoverAgv.

stop_or_escalate_if: The POST RecoverAgv operation is not available.
The API client cannot open or submit the operation.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: The AGVs API list identifies POST RecoverAgv; Recover AGV requires the robot ID and sends a request to Geek to add the specified AGV to the system.
OptiSweep provides APIs to get data and make requests; Apidog is installed on the primary servers.

steps.title: Enter the confirmed robot ID
steps.purpose: Identify the specific AGV that the RecoverAgv request will add back into the system.
steps.instruction: In the POST RecoverAgv request in the Apidog / WCS API client, provide the confirmed robot ID for the specified AGV.
steps.expected_result: The RecoverAgv request contains the robot ID for the intended AGV and is ready for submission.
steps.healthy_condition: The robot ID is present and has been confirmed as belonging to the intended AGV.
steps.failure_condition: The robot ID is missing, unconfirmed, or does not identify the intended AGV.

actions.label: Confirm robot ID
actions.exact_action: Provide the robot ID required by RecoverAgv.

stop_or_escalate_if: The robot ID cannot be confirmed.
The request does not provide a way to specify the robot ID.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Recover AGV is the Geek Plus equivalent of Add AGV and requires the robot ID.

steps.title: Submit the POST RecoverAgv request
steps.purpose: Send the recovery request through the OptiSweep / WCS API to request that Geek add the specified AGV to the system.
steps.instruction: Submit the POST RecoverAgv request in the Apidog / WCS API client after confirming that the intended robot ID is present.
steps.expected_result: The POST RecoverAgv request is submitted for the specified robot ID.
steps.healthy_condition: The WCS API client accepts the request for submission without a client-side submission failure.
steps.failure_condition: The request cannot be submitted or the API client reports a submission failure.
stop_or_escalate_if: The robot ID is not confirmed before submission.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Recover AGV sends a request to Geek to add the specified AGV to the system.

steps.title: Verify the AGV in Get Agv Statuses
steps.purpose: Confirm in live WCS API state that the specified AGV is represented again after the recovery request.
steps.instruction: Use the GET Get Agv Statuses operation in the Apidog / WCS API client and inspect the returned AGV entries for the specified robot ID. Review the returned name, state, command status, battery, status, errorCode, errorDescription, errorCause, systemErrorDescription, systemErrorResolution, and errorAlert fields when present.
steps.expected_result: The returned AGV status data contains an entry for the specified robot ID, representing the AGV again in the system state.
steps.healthy_condition: The specified robot ID is present in Get Agv Statuses and the returned status does not indicate an active error for that AGV, such as errorAlert true or populated error fields.
steps.failure_condition: The specified robot ID is absent from Get Agv Statuses, or the returned AGV data indicates an error state that prevents confirmation of recovery.

actions.label: Request AGV statuses
actions.exact_action: Use GET Get Agv Statuses to show the current state of AGVs.

actions.label: Check specified robot
actions.exact_action: Inspect the returned AGV status data for the specified robot ID.

stop_or_escalate_if: The specified AGV does not reappear in the returned system state.
The returned status shows an AGV error or system error that is not resolved by the recovery request.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Get AGV status shows the current state of AGVs, current command, vitals, AGV errors, and system errors. The displayed fields include name, state, commandGuid, commandName, commandStatus, battery, voltage, status, IP, errorCode, errorDescription, errorCause, systemErrorDescription, systemErrorResolution, and errorAlert.

success_criteria: The POST RecoverAgv request is submitted with the confirmed robot ID.
Get Agv Statuses returns an entry for the specified robot ID.
The specified AGV is represented again in the OptiSweep system state.
The returned AGV status does not show an unresolved error condition that prevents recovery confirmation.
healthy_conditions: The POST RecoverAgv operation is available in the AGVs API group.
The request contains a confirmed robot ID.
The specified robot ID is present in Get Agv Statuses after submission.
The returned AGV status fields do not indicate an unresolved AGV or system error.
failure_conditions: The POST RecoverAgv operation is unavailable or cannot be submitted.
The robot ID is missing or cannot be confirmed.
The specified robot ID does not reappear in Get Agv Statuses.
The returned AGV status indicates an unresolved error or system error.
escalation_guidance: Escalate to L3_support if the POST RecoverAgv request cannot be submitted.
Escalate to L3_support if the specified AGV does not reappear in Get Agv Statuses.
Include the specified robot ID and the returned AGV status or error fields when escalating, if available.
